commands.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const input=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("input.json","utf8"));const result=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("result.json","utf8"));const expected=input.rows.map(r=>({id:r.id,netCents:(r.quantity-r.returned)*r.unitCents})).sort((a,b)=>a.id<b.id?-1:a.id>b.id?1:0);const expectedTotal=expected.reduce((s,l)=>s+l.netCents,0);if(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(result).sort())!==JSON.stringify(["lines","totalCents"]))throw new Error("unexpected top-level keys");if(result.lines.length!==expected.length)throw new Error("line count mismatch");for(let i=0;i<expected.length;i++){if(result.lines[i].id!==expected[i].id)throw new Error("id mismatch at "+i);if(result.lines[i].netCents!==expected[i].netCents)throw new Error("netCents mismatch at "+i);if(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(result.lines[i]).sort())!==JSON.stringify(["id","netCents"]))throw new Error("unexpected line keys at "+i);}if(result.totalCents!==expectedTotal)throw new Error("totalCents mismatch");const zeroRows=expected.filter(l=>l.netCents===0);for(const z of zeroRows){if(!result.lines.some(l=>l.id===z.id&&l.netCents===0))throw new Error("missing zero-value row "+z.id);}console.log("verified",result.lines.length,"lines, total",result.totalCents);'

scope: One development case, not held-out superiority or general correctness. Generated verifier recomputes the same formula; separate fixed oracle and mutation checks provide additional evidence.
